I’m so excited to share that I had the opportunity to test out the Sony FX5 these past few weeks! I brought it with me around some of the lesser explored places in Manila, like Dangwa. Here are my favorite features! Open Gate - So excited about this one because Sony finally listened! You shoot once and you can get a frame that you can reshape however you want: horizontal or vertical, it’s really up to you! As a creator who has both Instagram and YouTube, it’s so exciting to finally have the Open Gate feature because now I don't have to worry so much about compromising a good frame   Triple Base ISO (800 / 4000 / 12800) - Before, I’d often feel the big jump from one base ISO to another. The FX5 gives you more options so the transition feels smoother. Two features and they've already changed how I plan a shoot 🤍 Lighting the way forward with the Sony FX5. #CinemaLineFX5 ​ #SonyAlpha​ #SonyPH The biggest thank you's to @juanderwater for helping me film BTS for this, and to @diarynijib and @charlyn_cua for the assist! 🎬✨️ #cinematography #traveltiktok

Hopefully not too late to join the trend 🎬 if Spider-Man: Brand New Day end credits were shot in Bangkok, Thailand I’ve been living in Bangkok for more than 10 years and never really had the time to explore all its locations and beauty so I used this trend as an excuse to finally go explore the city and practice my cinematography skills. Locations I visited: - Chatuchak - Benjakitti Park - Siam - Central Park - Chong Nonsi - Hua Lamphong - Yaowarat - Flower Market - Wat Paknam - Royal Pavilion Mahajetsadabadin 10 locations in 1 day, from 9am till 9pm. I can’t believe we really did that 😱 it was an awesome experience! Everything was shot in S-Log3 on the @sonyalpha a7III, graded in DaVinci (I’m still learning grading, so please go easy on me 🙏). Hopefully in the future I can do more things like this. #spiderman #brandnewday #cinematography #cinematic #trend

Montenegro is easily my least favourite county I’ve visited in Europe & second least favourite in the whole world…  I I think the country itself is absolutely stunning, but that is about it. In Montenegro, my experience was that the systems, the infrastructure, the people do not make for a good trip.  I was so excited to visit as Montenegro has been on my list for a long time and I hear so many good things about the country on social media so so I’m not gonna lie I was completely shocked that we had a negative experience there.  I found it interesting because I actually love the Balkans and I’ve been to many Balkan countries, but this was completely different.   Montenegro was the first time I’ve TRULY experienced pure racism abroad. The people will completely dismiss you, not serve you and will mutter racist comments under their breath.  What I will say is the locals in Montenegro definitely don’t like tourists which is fine, but they CERTAINLY do not like black tourists at all which I found really surprising because I see so many black people going to Montenegro and saying they enjoyed it? Nevertheless, again this was just OUR experience.  The buses in Montenegro either don’t come or you are waiting at least half an hour for them. The longest we waited was around an hour and 20 minutes for a bus from Budva to Kotor and in the end in never came.  The men in Montenegro are also another factor which made our trip an unpleasant experience. They beep at you in their cars, secretly film you and one even followed us from the beach.  I will never step for him Montenegro again and if you were to ask me if I would recommend Montenegro to other people, I would say absolutely not.  #montenegro #budva #kotor #balkan #travel  Why I would never go back to Montenegro | racism in Montenegro | black girls in Montenegro
